name: @unicitylabs/native-bridge-plugin
build: npm ci --ignore-scripts (repo root, with its vendored SDK and bridge-core tarballs)
npm run build (in packages/native-bridge-plugin: tsc -p tsconfig.json -> lib/)

package.json: drop the file: dependencies on @unicitylabs/bridge-core and @unicitylabs/state-transition-sdk and declare both as peerDependencies "*" (written with JSON.stringify(p, null, 2), no trailing newline), so the wallet's own vendored SDK and bridge-core are used
verified: 2026-11-20: built from c9aa333977 (native bridge v2: entry ./nb2, protocol 9; the commit deploy/testnet/bridge/pins.json names and a release manifest's bridge.sources carries). Its vendor/ SDK (4.0.0-utb.c5840ef) and bridge-core (0.1.0-bridge.2) tarballs are byte-identical to this directory's, so the wallet has one SDK copy. Re-packing gives the same files but another tarball sha256 (gzip/npm metadata), so check the contents, not the tarball hash.
notes: The plug-in is the native bridge v2 wallet library (NativeBridgeV2, the verifier, the journal contract, the gas model) and the shared trust input. The package root holds only bytes, errors, the trust input and its refresh; the bridge is the ./nb2 entry. The wallet builds against this commit and warns when a deployment's nb2-release.json names another.
